fusions.name: Braided Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes a target up to 5 tiles away with a braided cord, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Fine-Tooth Pass
fusions.desc: Sweeps a cone 4 tiles ahead of you with fine filaments, which deals 26 damage to everything in it and ignores armour.

fusions.name: Plaited Cordon
fusions.desc: Strings a plaited cordon 6 tiles long across the ground ahead of you for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it.

fusions.name: Strand by Strand
fusions.desc: Every hit you land ties a strand to that enemy, up to 6. Your next critical hit on it spends them all: the strands pull tight and strike it for 27% of your weapon damage per strand (163% at full). Unfed, a strand fades every 4 seconds.
